wish: someone should make a Pokedex that records all the semi-trucks you have seen, with images and descriptions
spec:
A dex of 15 common North American semi-truck models, each with a silhouette, short description and how to tell it apart.
Tap a model, tap Seen one, optionally add a place and a photo; sightings are saved on the device.
It does not identify trucks from photos and has no network access.
notes: Photos are downscaled to 200px and stored in localStorage.
